data.summary: The eval-svc pod took 25.0 s to become ready, breaching the 10.0 s threshold. While image pulling and application initialisation completed in 6.113 s, the readiness probe configuration delayed Kubernetes marking the pod as ready by an additional 18.887 s. This was caused by a high initialDelaySeconds and periodSeconds setting of 20 seconds on the readiness probe.

findings.statement: The startup total duration was 25.0 s against a 10.0 s SLO threshold.
Application initialisation completed in 1.013 s, with startup finishing at 6.113 s into the pod lifecycle.
The readiness phase consumed 18.887 s due to a readiness probe configured with initialDelaySeconds=20 and periodSeconds=20.

recommendations.action: Adjust readiness probe parameters by reducing initialDelaySeconds and periodSeconds.
recommendations.rationale: Lowering initialDelaySeconds and periodSeconds allows Kubernetes to detect application readiness sooner after app startup finishes.
